projects.title: Subenum
projects.description: A modular reconnaissance pipeline that brings passive subdomain discovery, optional active DNS enumeration, HTTP probing, and web crawling into one workflow for security researchers.
features: Combines multiple discovery tools and sources
Enriches results with DNS records and web metadata
Organizes live hosts and scan artifacts into structured reports

projects.title: CACTF
projects.summary: Learn web security by finding the flaws.
projects.description: An intentionally vulnerable web security lab with 16 capture-the-flag challenges. Practice finding flaws in authentication, access controls, input handling, and application logic.
features: 16 challenges covering SQL injection, XSS, IDOR, and more
Capture flags and track progress on the scoreboard
Persistent player progress backed by Postgres

projects.title: ISC2 CC Prep
projects.summary: Practice, review, and find your weak spots.
projects.description: An independent study app for the ISC2 Certified in Cybersecurity certification. Switch between timed practice exams and untimed study sessions, then review explanations and performance across five domains.
features: Choose 50 or 100 questions with shuffled answers
See domain scores and focused study suggestions
